title: Ember Dragon Ranches
caption:
This company's cranes have wings.

Ember Dragon Ranches breeds and trains dragons for heavy lifting. It rents them to builders by the hour, trains the handlers who fly them, and sells dragon fire to steelworks as forge heat.

Its edge is decades of careful breeding. The risks: dragons eat a lot, insurance isn't cheap, and Griffin Air Freight competes for the same jobs.

narration: This company's cranes have wings. Meet Ember Dragon Ranches, from the dragons and creatures industry on Meme Street's fictional market. It breeds and trains dragons, then puts them to work lifting things nothing else can. It rents dragons to builders by the hour, trains the handlers who fly them, and even sells dragon fire to steelworks as forge heat. That means bridges across canyons, and towers on mountainsides, built where no crane could ever reach. Its edge is decades of careful breeding. Strong, calm, trainable dragons take generations, and that's very hard for anyone to copy. The risks? Dragons eat a lot, insurance isn't cheap, and Griffin Air Freight competes for the same jobs. On Meme Street, stories like these hit the news wire, and the price reacts. Find Ember Dragon Ranches, at memestreet.net.
